Map of canopy height, segment priority, and strike trees

Source: R/plot.R
plot_risk_map.Rd

Segment colour is the canopy area inside the clearance envelope under the pessimistic (lower) conductor bound - where to verify first, not a finding. Zero is drawn as absence (a thin neutral line), never as the pale end of the risk ramp. Line type is the confidence: dashed where the tier depends on the unknown conductor elevation, dotted where too little of the corridor was observed to claim no risk ("no data"). Cells the LiDAR did not observe are drawn grey and their area is reported, so unseen never reads as clear. Strike trees are ink dots (both bounds) or paper dots (one bound); supports used for the upper bound are crosses.

Usage

plot_risk_map(
  rasters,
  risk,
  structures = NULL,
  encroach_limits = c(0, NA),
  title = "Vegetation risk along the line",
  source = "USGS 3DEP LiDAR",
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

rasters

Output of corridor_rasters().

risk

Output of assess_risk().

structures

OSM structures and line vertices (sf), optional.

encroach_limits

Range of the encroachment ramp (m^2). The lower end is zero; an NA upper end is the largest value on the map. Set both to share one ramp across maps.

title

Plot title.

source

Data credit shown in the subtitle.

file

Output PNG path, or NULL to return the plot.
